purpose: This module implements windowed detection of more than 2 people in a badminton court from per-frame over-count signals. It applies a fraction-based rule where a span is flagged as doubles if over-count is true for more than DOUBLES_SPAN_FRACTION of its frames. The module can run as a CLI tool to batch-process directories of over-count arrays into doubles_flags.csv output.

public_api.name: read_whole_video_flags
public_api.role: Load whole-video doubles verdicts from CSV written by this module, filtering for rows with empty rally_id. Callers use this to retrieve previously computed doubles flags for downstream processing.

public_api.name: doubles_flag
public_api.role: Compute the doubles verdict for one span of per-frame over-count data (or the whole array if span is None) using the rule: return True if mean(overcount) > DOUBLES_SPAN_FRACTION. Core logic that callers invoke to determine if a video or rally has >2 people in-court.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point to sweep a directory of <video_id>_overcount.npy arrays into doubles_flags.csv. Callers invoke this as a command-line tool with --overcount-dir and optional --rally-spans arguments.
